Chapter 640: Chapter 48: Lin Yuan’s Threat Level (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

“`

Fusing the Space Rules with some basic rules is a prerequisite for breaking through from Eighth Layer to Ninth Layer, and at the Tenth Layer, one needs to fuse even more rules. Apart from the Rule of Time, other pillar rules can also be attempted for fusion.

For example, the Life and Death Samsara Rule, formed from the fusion of the pillar rules of life and death, has astonishing killing power, and no amount of Spatial Layers can block it.

Of course, whether it is the rule of life or the rule of death, both are pillar rules, and the fusion between pillar rules is by no means a simple matter.

Therefore, the strength of life at the Tenth Layer has no specific standard and is assessed solely based on the level of threat posed.

The major cosmic races use a unified standard to categorize the threat level of Tenth Layer life into six levels.

...

Grade A, Grade B, Grade C, Grade D, Grade E, and Grade F.

Life that has just stepped into the Tenth Layer generally falls at ‘Grade F’ level, having opened millions of Spatial Layers and still being in the initial stage of rule fusion.

Let alone the fusion between pillar rules, even the fusion between a pillar rule and an ordinary rule, they only have that one kind achieved upon breaking through to the Ninth Layer.

Among Tenth Layer life, ‘Grade F’ is the weakest, and ‘Grade A’ is the strongest.

Generally, a ‘Grade A’ Tenth Rangler has fused two kinds of pillar rules, and some extremely powerful ‘Grade A’ entities have even fused the Rule of Time with some ordinary rule.

The fusion of a pillar rule with an ordinary rule does not necessarily require full comprehension of that pillar rule.

Just like the fusion of Space Rules with ordinary rules, one only needs to understand the Space Rules partially to proceed with the fusion.

“Just stepped into Tenth Layer, and within a thousand years has reached ‘Grade B’ threat level, and within five thousand years, there’s a good chance of reaching ‘Grade A’ threat level?”

Many Godlords present at the scene felt suffocated—the Eleventh Rank Godlord who had spoken rated the Galaxy Master too highly.

“I am simply extrapolating based on the Galaxy Master’s current strength and growth rate in the past, which led me to this conclusion,” said the Eleventh Rank Godlord, whose tone remained calm, but his heart was also in turmoil. How long had it taken him when he first stepped into Tenth Layer to reach ‘Grade A’?

“This is also a good thing,”

“Having knowledge in advance of the Galaxy Master’s future strength.”

At this moment, another Eleventh Rank Powerhouse spoke up. Whether it was Grade B or Grade A Tenth Rank, knowing made them easier to handle, at least making it possible to take targeted measures.

If they hadn’t probed this time, they would not have known the specific strength of the Galaxy Master after stepping into the Tenth Layer. What if they dispatched Grade D or Grade C Tenth Rank to confront him in a large-scale battlefield? Wouldn’t that be sending them to their doom?

Even the weakest ‘Grade F’ at the Tenth Layer level is the elite foundation of a clan, and can’t be sacrificed lightly.

This is still the case for Peak Clans. For a powerful clan, Tenth Layer life is the mainstay of the clan.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared, arriving at the deepest part of the Secret Realm.

At the same time, he was sensing every little detail within the Secret Realm, especially in the inner area, where many Alien Strong Ones had fled to.

In order not to reveal too much strength and to conceal the fact that he had become the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Lin Yuan could not kill these Ninth Rank Alien Race directly.

He could only wait until the Secret Realm closed, let them be wiped out by the Secret Realm at once, and then ‘collect the corpses’ himself.

“Eight thousand seven hundred and ninety-two Ninth Rank aliens…” Lin Yuan easily determined the number of aliens in the inner area through his control over the Secret Realm.

“With so many Ninth Rank aliens, how much loot will they bring me?” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

“`

Ever since the Xuanhuang Secret Realm opened, there were over two hundred Ninth-tier Secret Treasures obtained by those who attempted to stay within the realm and were subsequently eradicated.

It might not seem like a lot, but those Ninth Rank Alien Strong Ones who tried to remain in the secret realm had all prepared for death and had taken their treasures out through various means.

So, in total, there were less than three hundred Ninth-tier Secret Treasures.

However, the situation with the over eight thousand Ninth Rank Alien Race beings who hid in the inner areas was different.

They had made absolutely no preparations at all, and the Secret Treasure Weapons they carried were still with them. Although they weren’t too precious, the sheer quantity was overwhelming.

“Just perfect.”

“Cultivating the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’, what I lack the most is all kinds of resources, be it Secret Treasures or weapons, all of them can serve as nourishment for the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The three great Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Profound Yellow Lineage, known for the unyielding and undying ‘Xuanhuang Physique’, required a vast number of Xuanhuang Crystals for cultivation, in addition to various other resources.

Secret Treasures and weapons could all be devoured and then transformed into the foundation of the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’.”

With abilities like “Mysterious Yellow Strike” and “Steps of Space and Time,” Lin Yuan could also rely on his heaven-defying perception to quickly cultivate them to the level of Grand Perfection.

But ‘Xuanhuang Physique’, at its essence, was an accumulation of resources, and this aspect couldn’t rely solely on perception; a substantial investment of resources was essential.

Lin Yuan wasn’t just cultivating the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ with his True Body; his two Primordial Spirits also needed to cultivate the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’, making the demand for resources evident.

But with the contribution of nearly ten thousand beings from Different Species, Lin Yuan was convinced that his progress in cultivating the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ would be swift.

In fact, even if Lin Yuan obtained those Secret Treasure Weapons, he couldn’t easily reveal them without risking identification.

Therefore, he simply decided to use them all as nourishment for the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’, saving himself the trouble of acquiring other resources to supply the cultivation of this Secret Technique.

“The most pressing matter now is to refine the Core of the Secret Realm as quickly as possible.”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with the yellowish crystal floating before him.

Even when he had acted against the ‘Children of the Tree Realm’ and other legendary Ninth Rank beings not long ago, Lin Yuan maintained the refining of the Core of the Secret Realm.

The powerful onlookers all thought that in order to suppress the ‘Children of the Tree Realm’ among the four legendary Ninth Ranks, Lin Yuan had gone all out.

Sparing no effort to unleash Secret Techniques.

Little did they know that Lin Yuan was merely toying with them, utilizing only two billion out of the more than twenty billion Spatial Layers he occupied.

As for a burst Secret Technique? “Mysterious Yellow Strike,” once mastered, would become ‘permanent’, enabling every strike to unleash power beyond one’s own limits.

Besides consuming a bit more energy, it required no other price to pay.

The reason he didn’t pursue to kill was just taking advantage of the situation.

Those Ninth Rank Alien Strong Ones who fled to the inner area would sooner or later be eradicated by the secret realm, and their Treasure Weapons, and even corpses, would all end up in Lin Yuan’s hands.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, a year had gone by.

And Lin Yuan’s refining of the Core of the Secret Realm was approaching its final moment.
